title: Equation Ledger Wave 005 — Door, Window, Screen, Aperture, Drain and Transition
status: typed equation registry for Door/interface research
purpose: Register equations introduced or promoted by the Door embodiment census, distinguishing established science, archive formalization and earlier project equations. The ledger prevents one visual Door metaphor from silently inheriting equations belonging to a different boundary type.

entries.project_use: Canonical comparison vector for Door embodiments; components are typed metadata rather than quantities to sum.

entries.project_use: Generic representation of a boundary between two regions.

Smooth access model when passage is probabilistic rather than hard binary.

global_rules: Do not transfer an equation from one Door family to another without matching state space, carrier and operation.
Boundary equations are carrier-specific: a window can transmit photons and block bodies.
Screen edges define observation support, not the physical edge of reality.
A Pineal timing equation is a circadian/oscillator comparator, not evidence of a spiritual portal.
Drain/sink, phase transition, quantum tunneling, stochastic escape and authorization are distinct transition mechanisms.
A Door crossing should be defined by post-transition state/regime persistence where the domain permits measurement.
Historical Tim equations and later archive equations remain separately labeled.
